passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My mom is my hero, and she gets up early.
She cares for our family every day.
Sometimes she is tired, but she still has a smile.
phrases.ko: 가끔 엄마는 피곤하지만 그래도 미소가 있어요.

phrases.en: I love my mom, and I thank my hero.
phrases.ko: 나는 엄마를 사랑하고, 나의 영웅에게 감사해요.

phrases.en: She cares for my little sister and for me.
Her warm heart makes our home soft.
phrases.ko: 엄마의 따뜻한 마음이 집을 포근하게 해요.

phrases.en: She is early to the kitchen every morning.
phrases.ko: 엄마는 매일 아침 일찍 부엌에 있어요.

phrases.en: Even when she is tired, she listens.
phrases.ko: 피곤할 때도 엄마는 내 말을 들어요.

phrases.en: A hero can be a mom with a kind smile.
phrases.ko: 영웅은 친절한 미소를 가진 엄마일 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I love her with all my heart.

full_passage_spoken: My mom is my hero, and she gets up early. She cares for our family every day. Sometimes she is tired, but she still has a smile. She has a warm heart. I love my mom, and I thank my hero. She cares for my little sister and for me. Her warm heart makes our home soft. She is early to the kitchen every morning. Even when she is tired, she listens. A hero can be a mom with a kind smile. I love her with all my heart.
